source: Wording for Approval: Quick-Check Question, Coping Cards and Self-Help Guides (11 Nov 2026), approved by the project psychiatrist. Copied word for word; do not reword. Option B chosen: ASQ question 2. "Yes" opens the crisis screen and alerts a clinician.

text.en: In the past few weeks, have you felt that you or your family would be better off if you were dead?
